news.paragraph: The United States Oil Fund (USO) has seen significant gains in 2026, doubling in value, but now faces conflicting pressures from supply concerns and potential capacity recovery. Recent reports highlight how crude inventory declines have impacted USO, while also noting that proposed sanctions waivers could influence oil prices. The ETF is navigating a complex environment with supply disruptions and geopolitical factors at play.
